texts.arguments: 2. Anil Katyal and Sh. Hardeep Singh Banga, were let-off by the first appellate court. Ms. Tiwari places reliance on a judgment passed by a Division Bench of the Bombay High Court in Nestle India Limited vs. Food Safety and Standards Authority of India & Ors.1.
